title: Amazon API Gateway REST API to Amazon DynamoDB
description: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API that integrates with an Amazon DynamoDB table

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern creates an Amazon API Gateway REST API that integrates with an Amazon DynamoDB table named "Music". The API includes an API key and usage plan. The DynamoDB table includes a Global Secondary Index named "Artist-Index". The API integrates directly with the DynamoDB API and supports PutItem and Query actions.
The REST API uses an IAM role to provide full access to the specific DynamoDB table and index created by the CloudFormation template.
